verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-export feature or open-format bulk export for leaving Linear. The GraphQL API and MCP server are developer building blocks a user could use to build their own export, which earns no credit. The Markdown availability of linear.app pages covers the vendor's own site content, not user workspace data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
